# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-docs.mjs — do not edit by hand. -->

This page is generated from `COMMAND_REGISTRY` and co-located documentation
metadata (`core/scripts/command-docs.ts`). Do not hand-edit the command inventory.

Host skills use the same inventory with host-specific invocation tokens:
`/pipeline` (Claude Code) and `$pipeline` (Codex). The Node CLI is `pipeline`.

Regenerate with `node scripts/generate-docs.mjs` (or `npm run docs:generate`).

## Commands

### Advance & durable runs

#### `advance`

- **Usage:** `pipeline N`
- **Summary:** Durable autonomous one-item drive (default when invoked with an issue number)

#### `loop`

- **Usage:** `pipeline loop --milestone <m>|--label <l>|--range a-b [--resume <run-id>] [--audit] [--follow]`
- **Summary:** Durable multi-item run — driven in-repo by the pipeline's own loop supervisor

#### `run`

- **Usage:** `pipeline run <n> [--detach]`
- **Summary:** Advance alias; use with --detach for a legacy raw detached run (desktop launchers)

#### `single`

- **Usage:** `pipeline single <n>`
- **Summary:** Canonical durable one-item autonomous drive (owns a durable loop; delegates stages to advance)

### Lifecycle & release

#### `cleanup`

- **Usage:** `pipeline cleanup`
- **Summary:** Sweep merged-PR worktrees and delete their local branches

#### `doctor`

- **Usage:** `pipeline doctor`
- **Summary:** Deterministic preflight check; print summary, exit 0/1

#### `init`

- **Usage:** `pipeline init`
- **Summary:** Ensure pipeline labels and scaffold .github/pipeline.yml

#### `merge`

- **Usage:** `pipeline merge <pr>`
- **Summary:** Human-only squash merge of a ready-to-deploy PR (never called by the advance loop)

#### `merge-queue`

- **Usage:** `pipeline merge-queue --milestone <m> [--apply] [--release-when-complete --release-version <ver>]`
- **Summary:** Human-gated sequential merge of ready-to-deploy PRs; optional prepare-only release-when-complete

#### `override`

- **Usage:** `pipeline override <n> "<key>: <reason>"`
- **Summary:** Disposition a review finding and auto-resume the advance loop

#### `release`

- **Usage:** `pipeline release <version> [--theme "..."] [--dry-run]`
- **Summary:** Prepare a release PR for the given version (never tags, merges, or publishes)

#### `remove-worktree`

- **Usage:** `pipeline remove-worktree <n> [--force]`
- **Summary:** Remove a managed pipeline worktree for an issue (optional --force)

#### `status`

- **Usage:** `pipeline status <n>`
- **Summary:** Read-only — print stage, blocker, PR, last review

#### `unblock`

- **Usage:** `pipeline unblock <n> "<answer>"`
- **Summary:** Post an answer and clear the blocked label

### Factory & backlog

#### `backfill`

- **Usage:** `pipeline backfill [--apply] [--capability <name>]`
- **Summary:** Preview or apply OpenSpec coverage for legacy behavior (spec-only PR)

#### `evals`

- **Usage:** `pipeline evals plan|run|grade|report|harvest …`
- **Summary:** Offline eval plan/run/grade/report/harvest (never writes to production GitHub)

#### `factory-gate`

- **Usage:** `pipeline factory-gate --for <version> [--from-run <run-id>] [--observations <file>] [--scenario id=status:detail]`
- **Summary:** Score a durable loop / fixture pack and write immutable FRG evidence (never merges or tags)

#### `improve`

- **Usage:** `pipeline improve [--apply] [--top <n>] [--json]`
- **Summary:** Cluster papercuts / corrections / durable-run blockers into backlog candidates

#### `intake`

- **Usage:** `pipeline intake --description "<text>" [--release vX.Y.Z] [--dry-run]`
- **Summary:** Spec a rough description into a GitHub issue and ROADMAP PR

#### `queue`

- **Usage:** `pipeline queue [--max-issues <n>] [--concurrency <n>] [--budget-dollars <d>]`
- **Summary:** Batch factory: dispatch all pipeline:ready issues up to concurrency/budget limits

#### `refine-spec`

- **Usage:** `pipeline refine-spec --title "<t>" --body "<b>"`
- **Summary:** Refine an existing issue's spec; non-mutating JSON output

#### `roadmap`

- **Usage:** `pipeline roadmap [--apply] [--next <n>]`
- **Summary:** Analyze open backlog into a dependency-aware scored roadmap

#### `sweep`

- **Usage:** `pipeline sweep [--apply] [--repo owner/name]`
- **Summary:** Batch re-spec thin issues and reconcile ROADMAP.md

#### `triage`

- **Usage:** `pipeline triage <n> --stage ready|backlog`
- **Summary:** Set a pre-pipeline stage label (ready or backlog) on an issue

### Observability

#### `correction`

- **Usage:** `pipeline correction record|attribute …`
- **Summary:** Record a correction event or attribute a control (append-only local ledger)

#### `logs`

- **Usage:** `pipeline logs [<run-id>] [--events] [-f] [--no-until-terminal]`
- **Summary:** List or stream pipeline run logs (events --follow exits 0 on terminal run_complete)

#### `report`

- **Usage:** `pipeline report [--yes]`
- **Summary:** Privacy-safe product-fault report preview/submit (optional; off by default in config)

#### `scoreboard`

- **Usage:** `pipeline scoreboard [--bucket day|week] [--by <dim>] [--html <path>]`
- **Summary:** Print read-only factory throughput/cost/reliability metrics from run artifacts

#### `summary`

- **Usage:** `pipeline summary <run-id>`
- **Summary:** Print the run evidence bundle for an issue number or exact run-id

### Config & discovery

#### `config`

- **Usage:** `pipeline config schema|validate|sync|repo-map …`
- **Summary:** Config schema, validate, sync scaffold, and repo-map mutations

#### `path`

- **Usage:** `pipeline path [--json]`
- **Summary:** Discover installed host skill paths (JSON-friendly for desktop integrators)
